crossRefs.note: because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
“Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to…
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

translations.web: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
translations.bsb: So this is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah. He did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God.
translations.kjv: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.
translations.asv: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah; and he wrought that which was good and right and faithful before Jehovah his God.
